**Project scope note**

Stacker is a deliberately narrow personal tool. Its purpose is to let you stack multiple *open windows from the same browser* into one live, synchronized group with an attached switcher widget.

Feature requests that would significantly expand the mission (for example: saved workspaces, launching browsers/profiles, managing arbitrary apps, cross-app automation, session restoration, or general window management) are unlikely to be accepted. 

Please review the [Project Philosophy section in CONTRIBUTING.md](../../CONTRIBUTING.md) before submitting. Small, focused improvements that stay within the current scope are always welcome and appreciated.
